methodology.environment: Local Next.js production next start, real hosted public Supabase reads
methodology.visits: Five fresh browser contexts. Each first archive/detail visit paired with repeat via homepage in same context. Server process is warm; browser first visit is not a Vercel cold start.
methodology.timer: Actual archive/detail anchor click to matching DOM and two animation frames. Detail additionally verifies visible body. Table ready means populated table rows, not a skeleton.
methodology.navigation: Homepage loaded before timing; Legislative menu opened immediately before archive anchor click. Natural Next Link prefetch stays enabled.
methodology.privacy: Only timing, byte/row counts, field names, public URLs and record number retained; no response text, cookies or credentials.
